authorization: 用户批准完成本轮十二个已提出的故事；沿用已确认的老连环画风格。本轮逐幅编辑检查，不代称用户逐幅审美确认。

source.excerpt: 季札之初使，北過徐君。徐君好季札劍，口弗敢言。季札心知之，爲使上國，未獻。還至徐，徐君已死，於是乃解其寶劍，繋之徐君塚樹而去。從者曰：「徐君已死，尚誰予乎？」季子曰：「不然。始吾心已許之，豈以死倍吾心哉！」
source.transcriptionNote: 复用现有已录入批次的逐字原文快照；底本定位、原件哈希及行号保留。电子本尚不宣称纸本异文全校。

panels.title: 途经徐国
panels.caption: 季札出使途中，拜访了徐君。
panels.scene: Wide scene of blue-robed Ji Zha visiting ochre-robed Lord of Xu in an ancient reception courtyard; sword hangs at Ji Zha waist.

panels.title: 目光落在剑上
panels.caption: 徐君看着季札的剑，十分喜欢，却没有开口。
panels.scene: Medium scene: Lord of Xu looks appreciatively at the sheathed bronze sword at Ji Zha waist, hands kept to himself.

evidence.excerpt: 徐君好季札劍，口弗敢言

panels.title: 心里记下了
panels.caption: 季札明白他的心意。但还要出使别国，他暂时没有赠剑。
panels.scene: Ji Zha notices Xu lord gaze, rests hand lightly near his own scabbard, thoughtful; no exchange happens.

evidence.excerpt: 季札心知之，爲使上國，未獻

panels.title: 再次归来
panels.caption: 等到季札返回徐国，徐君已经去世了。
panels.scene: Later journey: Ji Zha and brown-robed companion arrive at a quiet bare earthen grave beside a tree. Lord of Xu is absent, no ghost.

panels.title: 解下宝剑
panels.caption: 季札来到墓旁，解下自己的宝剑。
panels.scene: Close view of Ji Zha unfastening the red cord of the same sheathed sword from his waist beside the tomb tree.

panels.title: 挂在墓树上
panels.caption: 他把剑系在徐君墓旁的树上。
panels.scene: Ji Zha carefully ties the sheathed sword with red cord to a sturdy low branch beside the grave; sword is clearly visible and remains sheathed.

panels.title: 还送给谁呢
panels.caption: 随从问：“徐君已经去世，您还要把剑送给谁呢？”
panels.scene: Brown-robed companion looks puzzled and gestures toward sword hanging on the tree; Ji Zha turns calmly to answer.

panels.title: 不能背弃本心
panels.caption: 季札说：“我心里早已答应，难道因为他去世，就能违背自己的心意吗？”
panels.scene: Final quiet wide shot: Ji Zha and companion stand near tomb, the one sheathed sword hangs from tree in foreground. Warm restrained evening light, no ghost.

evidence.excerpt: 始吾心已許之，豈以死倍吾心哉

adaptations: 未写季札与徐君当面约定赠剑，不补口头承诺。
墓旁树木及服饰为艺术表现；不补徐君姓名，不赋予未核身份链接。

checks: 逐格核对情节、人物与关键道具
直接参考用户选定的徙木立信：夸张造型、简练黑线、平涂色块
无嵌入正文，无虚构结果

generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a finished Histree vintage Chinese lianhuanhua story atlas, exactly 8 sequential illustrations on ONE image. Primary request: 季札挂剑. Composition: STRICT equal rectangular grid of TWO columns and 4 rows. Read left to right, top to bottom. All row heights equal, all column widths equal. Canvas target 1024 x 1280. Narrow straight cream gutters, maximum 4 pixels; no outer margin, no header/footer; every scene fills its own complete LANDSCAPE cell. No merged panels, insets, or changes in layout.
Style: classic 1950s-1960s Chinese small-picture storybook, early Shanghai Animation folk-art sensibility. Graceful expressive fine ink outlines, hand-painted gouache, mineral blue/green, muted cinnabar and ochre, textured warm cream paper, restrained humor and human facial expressions. Rich but legible environments; varied wide/medium/close shots. NOT modern anime, 3D, glossy or photorealistic. Ancient China, no modern objects. No words, letters, numbers, captions, speech balloons, calligraphy, watermark or symbols that look like writing ANYWHERE. Clothing and face continuity within the atlas is essential.
Characters and invariants: Ji Zha: dignified middle-aged traveling nobleman in deep blue robe, dark simple crown, short black beard. ONE bronze straight sword in a plain dark scabbard with red cord, consistent throughout. Lord of Xu: older man in ochre robe, gray beard; alive only in first scenes. Companion: brown-robed adult traveler. Tomb is an uninscribed earth mound beside a tree, no modern gravestone or characters.
Scenes in this exact order:
1. Wide scene of blue-robed Ji Zha visiting ochre-robed Lord of Xu in an ancient reception courtyard; sword hangs at Ji Zha waist.
2. Medium scene: Lord of Xu looks appreciatively at the sheathed bronze sword at Ji Zha waist, hands kept to himself.
3. Ji Zha notices Xu lord gaze, rests hand lightly near his own scabbard, thoughtful; no exchange happens.
4. Later journey: Ji Zha and brown-robed companion arrive at a quiet bare earthen grave beside a tree. Lord of Xu is absent, no ghost.
5. Close view of Ji Zha unfastening the red cord of the same sheathed sword from his waist beside the tomb tree.
6. Ji Zha carefully ties the sheathed sword with red cord to a sturdy low branch beside the grave; sword is clearly visible and remains sheathed.
7. Brown-robed companion looks puzzled and gestures toward sword hanging on the tree; Ji Zha turns calmly to answer.
8. Final quiet wide shot: Ji Zha and companion stand near tomb, the one sheathed sword hangs from tree in foreground. Warm restrained evening light, no ghost.

styleRefinement.instructions: Use case: style-transfer. Restyle ONLY IMAGE 1, the edit target. IMAGE 2 (approved older 移木立信 artwork) is the PRIMARY style reference; IMAGE 3 (newly corrected fish-refusal artwork) is a SECONDARY reference for the same approved style. Do not import reference story events, characters, sword/pole/fish props, captions or text. Draw the target in the same artistic language as images 2 and 3: strongly designed Chinese folk/early Shanghai animation characters, larger expressive heads, compact stylized adult bodies, angular expressive eyebrows and noses made with very few confident strokes, small curved eyes, humorous expressive poses, fluid varied BLACK ink contours, FLAT matte pigment blocks with only spare broad ink-wash texture. Reduce realistic anatomy, skin modeling, facial shading, brocade patterns, tiny clothing folds and detailed background rendering dramatically. Robes are mostly solid muted color fields with spare trim, NO all-over elaborate embroidery. Simplify background buildings into rhythmic geometric silhouettes, light ink washes and warm UNPAINTED cream space. Restrained indigo, ochre and cinnabar, subtle paper grain like image 2, no dense brown texture overlay. NOT realistic illustrated portraiture, glossy painting, modern anime, chibi toys, 3D or photorealism. Keep all characters ADULT unless explicitly elderly. Preserve each character's consistent identifying robe color, beard and role, but redraw their form in this stylized way. No words, numerals, letters, title, captions, calligraphy, speech bubbles, watermark or readable marks ANYWHERE, including on documents, garments or props. Ignore all text visible in the style reference. Do not add a header or footer.
